name: A10-0083/2026 – Eleonora Meleti, Rosa Estaràs Ferragut – Motion for a resolution (as a whole)
title: REPORT on advancing towards a care society: addressing the gender care gap
part_text:
The European Parliament calls for a "care society" where care work is valued and shared equally between women and men. It asks EU countries to improve pay and conditions for care workers, support unpaid carers with leave, money and pension credits, and invest in affordable childcare and long-term care. It also wants better data on who provides care and a European action plan to close the gender care gap. This is an opinion; it does not change any law itself.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. Parliament asks for better pay, carers' leave and childcare, plus a European action plan.
- **Who it affects:** Women, who do most paid and unpaid care work, and the people they care for.
- **What happens next:** The European Commission is asked to act, including a European Care Deal promised for 2027.
